name: SOLO
source:
Can you imagine waking up one day and discover that you have no one with you? This is what has happened to Pol.

Will you be able to find out why he is so ALONE?

[From [url=https://javicoder.itch.io/solo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你能想象有一天一觉醒来，发现身边没有人吗？这就是波尔身上发生的事情。

你能找出他为何如此孤独吗？

[来自[url=https://javicoder.itch.io/solo]Itch.io[/url]]
